On the 238 between the leg tips it keeps (264 - 238) / 2 = 13 on each flat leg centred and 13 - (310 - 298) / 2 = 7 pushed fully to one side (6 for a 296 rim); the user accepted this in place of the 15 of roadmap 0022 (option A, frame unchanged). box_shape.status: The outer wall section is MEASURED 2026-10-28 by the user on a C2G43-12 and a C2G43-22 (roadmap 0004), both alike but for the height; the user's photos of the underside show the hollow bottom band and its cross ribs. Every reach is in from the 298 x 398 outline unless named otherwise. The ribs and webs on the walls, the pin blocks, the handle and the corner radii stay UNVERIFIED, read from aidB's product photos; the inner floor is SECONDARY (inner_floor_status). aidB states 'glatter Boden' (VERIFIED 2026-10-26): the box stands on its flat floor, the foot
box_shape.colour: neutral dark grey, about sRGB #3F3F3F on the lit faces of the photo

top_flange.note: at the rim, out to the outline; the wall below it stands 13 in (reach); the rim top measures about 16 across, MEASURED, so the wall under the rim is about 3.5, DERIVED from aidB's 265 inner top: (298 - 265) / 2 - 13

second_flange.note: its top face 30 below the rim, out to the outline, 14 out from the side panel below it

box_shape.panel_status: DERIVED: the side panel slopes from 14 in under the second flange to 17 in at the shoulder, the reach of the bottom band; 53 high on the 120 box, 153 on the 220 box (height - 30 - 2 - 13 - 17 - 5)

shoulder.note: slopes from the panel out to the bottom band; rounded about R2 where it meets the band's outer face (the user's estimate)

band.note: the bottom band: its outer face on the outline from 5 to 22 above the floor, a wall 4 thick; hollow and open towards the floor, a channel 13 wide between the wall and the foot; the model closes the channel at the band's top

foot.note: the flat floor the box stands on, 264 x 364, 5 below the band's edge, its face flush with the bottom of the side panel (flush is UNVERIFIED, an assumption)

cross_ribs.note: across the band's channel from the wall to the foot, evenly spaced, 11 on each long side and 7 on each short side, and one diagonal rib in each corner

box_shape.corner_posts: UNVERIFIED, read from aidB's product photo: each corner is solid from the bottom band up to the rim, its faces on the outline; the model fills the corner as deep as the section's recess
box_shape.inner_floor_status: box_models inner_floor_*: the inner wall tapers from the inner top to the floor. 120: SECONDARY, 359 x 259 is the inner floor of Bito XL43121 and Utz RAKO 400 x 300 x 120, and aidB's insert sets need at least 358 x 258. 220: DERIVED, the same wall slope over 215 instead of 115, 365 - 6 x 215 / 115 = 354

handle.handles: closed: a grip pocket, not an opening through the wall

clip.covers: the face of the handle frame, round the grip pocket

outline.status: MEASURED 2026-10-29 in motedis' CAD file P30_N8_B.stp (30x30 B-Type Slot 8.zip), the end face: eighth is one eighth of the outline from the V floor of the slot on the +x face to the start of the outer corner, centred on the profile axis, mirrored about the diagonal and turned four times; the R0.2 and R0.5 fillets are left out and their corners drawn at the lines' intersections; the outer corners R2. The file also has four corner chambers and the 7.3 core bore; the model leaves them out and closes the ends, since every profile end is covered by an end cap or stands against another profile

castor.brake: total lock (wheel and swivel): 'Lenkrolle mit nachlaufendem Totalfeststeller'
castor.offset_status: MEASURED 2026-10-26 in motedis' CAD file Motedis_06.07.02.stp: 24 between the bolt axis and the wheel axle; motedis writes Ausladung 25 on the page, the build follows the smaller and draws the wheel further in
castor.status: VERIFIED 2026-10-26, motedis 06.07.02: 'Raddurchmesser 75mm, Reifenbreite 25mm, Rueckenloch 11mm. Ausladung 25mm, Bauhoehe 100 mm. Tragfaehigkeit 60Kg', 22.83 EUR per 4 incl. VAT; motedis states no mass
castor.mass_kg_status: UNVERIFIED, about 0.30 taken as an upper bound from motedis' 100 mm castor 1748 (0.298 kg VERIFIED); the smaller wheel, the 32 mm narrower tread and the shorter fork should weigh less, the 125 mm 996 weighs 0.813
castor.top_plate_status: MEASURED 2026-10-26 in the CAD file: the fork's metal at the back hole is 11.15 thick and its underside is 11.15 below the mounting face. The washer and the head of the castor bolt sit under it inside the fork; the wheel's top stands 25 below the face, so 13.85 remain for them and screw.m8x35_socket fits (the build checks it)
castor.leg_width_status: MEASURED 2026-10-26 in the CAD file: the fork spans 43 across the tread and its legs end 30 above the floor
castor.boss_diameter_status: MEASURED 2026-10-26 in the CAD file: the fork material within 12 of the bolt axis reaches 11.75 from it, so 45 of inset keeps it inside the frame outline

sweep.status: DERIVED, the wheel: 24 + 37.5 in its plane, half the tread across, sqrt(61.5 squared + 12.5 squared). MEASURED, the brake: the farthest vertex of fork and pedal in the CAD file, 20 to 30 below the mounting face. Swept about the bolt at 45 in, the wheel passes the frame outline by 17.8 and the brake by 36.2, both below the castor plate at 100 and clear of every other part

castor.at: under a castor plate at each corner, centre 45 from both outer faces

head.note: (radius, height above the floor) revolved about the bolt axis: the boss with the 11 back hole and the swivel's ball race, down to the underside of the 11.15 metal at the hole

fork.note: one sheet: a half cylinder round the bolt axis on the side away from the wheel, and two flat side plates, 1.75 thick with their outer faces 21.5 from the middle, from it to the axle, each ending in a round eye about the axle

wheel.note: (along the axle from the wheel's middle, radius), mirrored about the middle and revolved about the axle: the polyurethane tread and the polypropylene centre; spacers from the hub to the fork's side plates

brake.note: the lever's two plates beside the wheel, the shoe across them over the tread, the pedal at their far end, y along the wheel's trail

shape.status: MEASURED 2026-10-29 in motedis' CAD file Motedis_06.07.02.stp: the boss 23.5 across at the face (boss_diameter), the ball race radius 21.7, the fork's round back radius 21.5 in a 1.75 sheet from about 34 above the floor up to the head, its side plates at 19.75-21.5 from the middle, the axle 6.1 with heads 11.6, an eye of radius 8 about the axle, the tread 37.5 in radius and 25 wide with R7.2 shoulders, the hub's rim at radius 24-27, the brake lever plates 14-15.75 from the middle and the pedal 28 wide reaching 79.9 from the bolt axis. The outline of the fork's side plates, the hub's recess, the brake shoe and the head's profile between the measured radii are drawn by eye after motedis' photo (UNVERIFIED)

upright_joints.by: the angles: angle.base at the bottom, angle.guard at the top
upright_joints.note: No profile is drilled or machined. Each upright end stands against its bar, held by the 40 x 40 x 4 angle beside it, which works as a bracket: 2 screw.m5x12_countersunk per end through the upright leg into the upright's slot and 2 through the flat leg into the bar's slot (angles.holes.flat_leg). The middle uprights get one on each side, the corner uprights one on the inner side
upright_joints.torque_status: UNVERIFIED: about 3 N m for the M5 screws into the hammer nuts, kept low because motedis publishes no rating for its hammer nuts

frame.castors_at: the four corners, each under a castor plate below the bottom bar and the bottom depth beam

slot.status: VERIFIED, measured in motedis' CAD file P30_N8_B.stp (30x30 B-Type Slot 8.zip), 2026-10-26: opening 8.0 at its narrowest, lip 2.2, slot 9.0 deep, undercut 16.5 wide, core bore 7.3. The model draws the slot as the CAD file has it (frame.profile.outline)

section.status: DERIVED from motedis' CAD file P30_N8_B.stp: area in mm2 by Green's theorem over the end face, mass at 2.70 g/cm3 in kg/m, I about the centroid in cm4; motedis publishes none of them (Dold gives 0.843 kg/m and 2.68 cm4 for the same section type)

inside_30.status: VERIFIED, read from motedis' CAD file Motedis_S8BBR30.stp: legs 27 long, 6 thick and 28 wide; a side wall 3 thick on each edge, a triangle cut off where the distances along both legs add up to 32.5; in each leg an elongated hole 7.0 to 20.7 from the corner, 6.4 to 7.0 wide (drafted, drawn 6.7). The model leaves out the centring pins (2.4 high) and the small chamfers; a screw sits in the middle of the hole, or on the slot's centre line where the leg crosses the slot

plate.status: VERIFIED: the same motedis Winkel 30 B-Typ Nut 8 as bracket.inside_30, sold without screws; its one screw and hammer nut in the bar are counted as screw.m6x12_button and tnut.m6

fasteners.screws_status: head_d and head_k of ISO 4762 M8 (13, 8) and ISO 7380-1 M6 (10.5, 3.3) VERIFIED from the standards' tables; ISO 10642 head_d is the DIN 7991 dk max (10, 12), VERIFIED, and head_k = (head_d - d) / 2 for the 90 degree head, DERIVED; length is the nominal length, which includes the head only for a countersunk screw; the wood screw's head is UNVERIFIED, no product is chosen. The M8 castor bolt is motedis' DIN 912 in stainless A2, 'Festigkeitsklasse von mindestens A2-50', VERIFIED 2026-10-25
fasteners.nuts_status: Hammer nuts VERIFIED, measured in motedis' CAD files Motedis_S8BHASNM6.stp and Motedis_S8BHASNM5.stp (2026-10-26): 16.5 x 8.0 x 6.0, the drawing also gives 16,5; drawn as a block across the slot. motedis publishes no load rating. DIN 985 M8: s 13 and h max 8 SECONDARY from a DIN 985 table (schrauben-lexikon.de); motedis states no size; drawn as a plain hexagon

cap.status: VERIFIED, motedis' Abdeckkappe fuer Profil 30 Typ B Nut 8: 30 x 30 x 3.7, black PA (2026-10-25); the model draws the flange only

angles.product: motedis Winkelstange eloxiert 40x40x4mm; alloy not stated

holes.status: UNVERIFIED, a proposal: in the leg against the upright, 15 from each end and 11 and 28 from the inner face of the flat leg, countersunk on the box side; the hole at 28 stays 8 from the leg tip, the head at 11 clears the root by 6

flat_leg.status: UNVERIFIED, a proposal: the joint holes of the base and guard angles, in the flat leg on the slot line of the bar under or over it (15 from each end), 14 and 32 from the upright face so the two hammer nuts (16.5 long) keep 1.5 between them; countersunk on the box side, the base angles' heads 0.1-0.2 below flush because the boxes slide over them

base.orientation: flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars, vertical leg up

support_and_guard.orientation: flat leg on top, hanging leg down along the upright

box_position.note: centred in the 435 depth, (435 - 398) / 2; no back stop

explode.note: the exploded view, mm a part moves from its place, in three steps so nothing passes through another part: the boxes straight out to the front, far enough that they stay in front of the rack while the rest moves (the build checks this), then their levels spread upwards (box_levels_apart) so each level's inserts clear the box above; then the rest, the uprights lifting off the bottom bars (uprights_up) as the top bars lift off the uprights (top_up), the inserts lifting out and the rings coming off. Castors stay on the floor, so every part moves up from the one below it. Set by eye, no fact

top_plate.role: structural: screwed to both top bars from below, plate and bar act as one composite chord that carries most of the middle uprights' load, so the bottom bar can be 30 x 30

mounts.note: bracket centres along each top bar, in its inner slot, free leg flush with the bar top under the plate; four in each outer bay where the shear acts, two in the middle bay where it is near zero; clear of the depth-beam brackets on the right of each upright; nothing shows on top. Each keeps its distance to the nearest upright's x from before the 318 bays of roadmap 0022

top_plate.visual_status: corner_radius R10 is the user's choice; plies, finish and colour are UNVERIFIED

parts.description: Upright between the bars, no machining; each end held by the base or guard angle beside it
Top bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns, no holes; the guard angles are screwed up into its bottom slot

Bottom bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns, flush with the bottom depth beams; shares the middle uprights' load with the top plate and top bar; no holes, the base angles are screwed down into its top slot
Depth beam between the front and the back bar at each upright, the top one flush with the top bars, the bottom one flush with the underside of the bottom bars
Level 1 support, flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars; also the bottom joint of the uprights: 4 holes in the vertical leg into the uprights and 4 in the flat leg into the bars
Level 2-5 support, flat leg on top, hanging leg guides the box below
Tip guard above level 5, same section and orientation as angle.support; also the top joint of the uprights: 4 holes in the hanging leg into the uprights and 4 in the flat leg up into the bars

Inside angle bracket 30 for B-type slot 8 (motedis Winkel 30 B-Typ Nut 8): upright to top depth beam (8), top depth beam to bar (8), bottom depth beam to bar on the beam's bay side at the middle uprights (4) and a second one on the other side there (4); at the corners the castor plate joins bottom bar and beam
Castor plate 90x90x8 under each corner, screwed into the bottom slots of the bottom bar and the bottom depth beam; 9 mm hole at 45/45 for the castor bolt, 4 countersunk holes for M6
ISO 7380 M6x12, 2 per bracket.inside_30 (48) and 1 per bracket.plate (20)
ISO 10642 M6x16 from below through the castor plates into the bottom slots, 4 per plate
Hammer nut M6 B-type slot 8 for the brackets (48), the plate brackets (20) and the castor plates (16)
ISO 10642 M5x12 for the angles, flush in a countersunk hole so the hanging leg stays smooth: 4 per support angle, 8 per base and guard angle (4 into the uprights, 4 into the bars)
Hammer nut M5 B-type slot 8 for the angles, in the uprights' slots (144) and the bars' slots (48)
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x35 from inside the castor housing up through the back hole and the castor plate's 9 mm hole into a lock nut
ISO 7089 (DIN 125 A) washer 8.4, one under the castor bolt's head inside the housing and one under its lock nut on the plate
DIN 985 M8 lock nut on top of the castor plate, holding the castor bolt
Swivel castor 75 mm with total-lock brake (motedis 06.07.02), 100 high, back hole 11, offset 24, 60 kg, under a castor plate at each corner
End cap 30x30 for the ends of the top and the bottom bars
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x120, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-12)
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x220, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-22), no inserts
ColorClip set blue, 2 rings (R200-00-02-SET), level 1
ColorClip set turquoise, 2 rings (R200-00-12-SET), levels 2 and 3
ColorClip set light green, 2 rings (R200-00-13-SET), levels 4 and 5
Insert set 1/2 for 400x300x120 (EES43-01-100-04): 2 x NextGen 3613-100
Insert set 1/4 for 400x300x120 (EES43-02-100-04): 4 x NextGen 1813-100
Top plate, birch plywood, grain along the 1114 length, corners rounded R10; structural, screwed to the top bars from below
Angle bracket 30 (motedis Winkel 30 B-Typ Nut 8, as bracket.inside_30), one screw.m6x12_button and tnut.m6 in the top bars' inner slots, 10 per bar at top_plate.mounts.x
Wood screw 4.5x16, pan head, from below through a bracket into a pre-drilled hole in the plate, 1 per bracket; at least 5 mm of wood stays above the tip

profile_30x30.note: motedis cuts each piece to size (Zuschnitt, 50-1980), so the cut list gives one row per piece

angle_40x40x4.note: motedis cuts whole bars to a list (Zuschnitt ganzer Stab): 3 trimmed off the start, 4 per cut, the rest at least 40; 1980 is motedis' longest bar and ships from stock in Germany
